patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Comparison thesis: Same category, different company size. Choose Magento only if your buying job matches “Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quote) — deep” rather than Square Online's shape. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than Magento's shape. Workflow advantage: Magento leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b; Square Online leans omnichannel-retail. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Magento is Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quote) — deep catalog/B2B with high hosting and agency TCO.; Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers.
- Company-size focus: Magento (mid-market, enterprise) vs Square Online (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Magento-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b, order-fulfillment vs Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: Magento — Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0; Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify.

Limitations — Magento: Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0; Adobe Commerce pricing is opaque (GMV quote) — hard to compare without a partner worksheet; Square Online: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Free tier online processing spread (3.3% + 30¢) can exceed paid-tier savings at volume.

Poor-fit cases: Magento is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0 · Square Online is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify · Avoid Magento if you actually need Square Online's motion (Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
